owner_directive: Build the complete repository-executed FRANK simulation Harness to release quality before LoRA-1.
coordination_rule: Every harness worker joins this workspace, reads all current branch inputs and live claims, claims a non-overlapping highest-value package, executes code/tests, cross-reads siblings and writes completion plus affected-branch feedback receipts.

H-WP-01-FREEZE-COMPILER.goal: Compile exact current compatible FRANK+overlay architecture freeze with hashes and module/state/transition graph.

H-WP-02-STATE-LEDGER.goal: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots and deterministic hashing.

H-WP-03-CLAYCODE-ADAPTER.goal: Integrate frozen ClayCode parser/canonicalizer/validator/evaluator and ClayReaderFrame projection.

H-WP-04-NEEDLE-BOUNDARY.goal: Model unchanged translator->Needle->Clay boundary and exact Needle receipts without merging Needle into model.

H-WP-05-UNIFIEDDB.goal: Typed logical query/result/selection/transaction/replay simulation with physical-placement separation.

H-WP-06-CLAYGRAPH.goal: Memory-use admissibility, routing, activation, Assembly, exact bypass, quarantine/escalation and scoped credit.

H-WP-07-GWT.goal: Competition, WorkspaceEpisode, broadcast envelope and per-receiver delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/reentry chain.

H-WP-08-SELF-BODY-GOALS.goal: Persistent personality/E-PQ, world/self model, DigitalBodyState, goals/commitments/reflection/drift state.

H-WP-09-MODEL-ADAPTER.goal: Narrow model interface with deterministic fixtures now and Together/Qwen adapter only after authorization.

H-WP-11-TRACE-REPLAY.goal: Complete per-turn trace bundles, full/checkpoint/module/counterfactual replay and golden traces.

H-WP-12-ABLATION.goal: Module lesions, policy swaps, state perturbations and matched counterfactual runner.

H-WP-13-RECOVERY.goal: Crash/restart, idempotency, stale epochs, partial-effect boundaries, rebuild and rollback tests.

H-WP-16-E2E.goal: Long-horizon multi-turn Test-1 simulations with deterministic model fixture and later Clay-native 4B.

H-WP-17-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Architecture coverage, state schemas, golden traces, replay validation, ablation matrix, tests and PASS decision.

live_claims.scope: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots, deterministic hashing and replay foundation
